<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion appears at m/z 183.0451. This mass is best explained as a sodium adduct ([M + Na]⁺) of a neutral molecule with an exact mass of ≈ 160.0559 Da. The formula C₁₀H₈O₂ has a calculated neutral exact mass of 160.0524 Da, which matches the observed mass within a few ppm, making it the most plausible molecular formula for the compound.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H8O2</final_answer>
